mapper.sql:
'02' type, tpd.CCY, tpd.FINPROD_ID, tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, tpd.CHL_ID, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, fprod_type.TYPE_6 assetType, nvl(tpda.PAY_TYPE,wtpda.PAY_TYPE) bonusMode, (case when nvl(tpda.PAY_TYPE,wtpda.PAY_TYPE) = #{BONUS_MODE_02} then nvl(tpda.BONUS_CFM_DATE,wtpda.BONUS_CFM_DATE) else null end) reInvesDate, tpd.INT_AMT tradeAmt, null qty, nvl(tpda.REG_DATE,wtpda.REG_DATE) registDate, tpd.TRADE_DATE exRightsDate, (case when nvl(tpda.PAY_TYPE,wtpda.PAY_TYPE) = #{BONUS_MODE_01} then nvl(tpda.BONUS_CFM_DATE,wtpda.BONUS_CFM_DATE) else null end) arriveDate,
null registShare, tpd.UNIT_CPRICE, tpd.B_TRADE_ID, tpd.P_TRADE_ID, tpd.PS, tpd.REMARK,

'03' type, tpd.CCY, tpd.FINPROD_ID, tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, tpd.CHL_ID, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, fprod_type.TYPE_6 assetType, nvl(tpda.PAY_TYPE,wtpda.PAY_TYPE) bonusMode, null reInvesDate, tpd.TRADE_AMT, null qty, nvl(tpda.REG_DATE,wtpda.REG_DATE) registDate, btrd.TRADE_DATE exRightsDate, tpd.TRADE_DATE arriveDate,
null registShare, tpd.UNIT_CPRICE, tpd.B_TRADE_ID, tpd.P_TRADE_ID, tpd.PS, tpd.REMARK,

'04' type, tpd.CCY, tpd.FINPROD_ID, tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, tpd.CHL_ID, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, fprod_type.TYPE_6 assetType, nvl(tpda.PAY_TYPE,wtpda.PAY_TYPE) bonusMode, tpd.TRADE_DATE reInvesDate, tpd.INT_AMT tradeAmt, tpd.SHARE_AMT qty, nvl(tpda.REG_DATE,wtpda.REG_DATE) registDate, btrd.TRADE_DATE exRightsDate, null arriveDate,
null registShare, tpd.UNIT_CPRICE, tpd.B_TRADE_ID, tpd.P_TRADE_ID, tpd.PS, tpd.REMARK,

left join PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tpda on tpda.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID
left join WFL_PA_TRD_FIN_DEAL_TOTAL wtpda on wtpda.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID
inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tpd.FINPROD_ID and fp.PROFIT_TYPE = #{PROFIT_TYPE_JZ}
left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fprod_type on fprod_type.FINPROD_ID = tpd.FINPROD_ID
left join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL btrd on btrd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.B_TRADE_ID
mapper.select: select fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, fp.CCY CCY, fpt.TYPE_6 assetType, fp.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fp.ISSUER from FIN_PRODUCT fp left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fpt.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID where fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId} AND fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F17'

select pp.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, pci.ACCT_NO secManageAcctId from PTL_PORTFOLIO pp left join PTL_CAPACCT_INFO pci on pci.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID and pci.ACCT_TYPE = #{ACCT_TYPE_A01}
pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}

choose.when:
select psp.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, psp.AMOUNT registShare,
pp.INVEST_YESORNO investYesorno,
psp.CDATE registDate from PTL_SEC_POSITION psp inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = psp.PORTFOLIO_ID where nvl(pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,'null') = 'null' and psp.CDATE = #{registDate,jdbcType=DATE} and psp.AMOUNT >0
AND PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{chlId}
AND PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID = '999999'
and fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and psp.HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE03} order by AMOUNT
choose.otherwise:
select deal.TRADE_ID tradeId, dealAdd.PORTFOLIO_ID, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, dealAdd.REG_DATE registDate, dealAdd.REG_DATE_AMT registShare, deal.UNIT_CPRICE unitCprice, deal.INT_AMT tradeAmt,
pp.INVEST_YESORNO investYesorno,
deal.SHARE_AMT qty
from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD dealAdd on deal.TRADE_ID = dealAdd.TRADE_ID
from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal left join WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD dealAdd on deal.TRADE_ID = dealAdd.TRADE_ID
left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on dealAdd.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID where deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode} and deal.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01}
and nvl(pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,'null') = 'null'
